notes.title: Eternal Destiny: Big Update & New DLC "The Attribute Sanctuaries"
notes.notes:
Free Update

Level Cap Breaker: Now you can increase your cards' levels to a maximum of 1000 by winning Level Cap Breaker battles! Additional skills will be obtained when your card level reaches 100, 500, and 1000.
Attribute Slot & Super Slot: Attribute slot such as water and flame and super slots with double-strength effect have been added! They are available in Challenge mode, Level Cap Breaker, and the new DLC.
New Commander Battle: Like a minesweeper, now you can obtain
 various items by winning the new commander battle!
Challenge Mode: Challenge mode now open with new three levels.

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/23341885/858c10f3df5f41e7e6ec0fde0c00074474620ca4.jpg


DLC "The Attribute Sanctuaries"
Dungeon: Attribute Sanctuaries - Easy (16 Attributes)
Dungeon: Attribute Sanctuaries - Normal (16 Attributes)
Dungeon: Attribute Sanctuaries - Hard (16 Attributes)
Bonus: Unevolved Card Set from Ranking Mode
* Many cards that do not appear in standard card packs are also introduced in this DLC.

http://store.steampowered.com/app/638950/Eternal_Destiny__The_Attribute_Sanctuaries/

notes.title: Eternal Destiny: Dungeon update & New dragon DLC release!
notes.notes:
Update Patch
Added new dungeon Cavern of Legends in the game!

New DLC "Dragon's Dawn: Revenge of Tiamat" is now available
New scenario: Reports of strange occurrences come in from all over the world... Could these be the precursor signs of the infamous dragon's dawn?
The sleeping dragons would destroy the world if they awaken! Agents are urgently ordered to investigate events in Bolivia.
New dungeon: Battle fearsome dragons in their nests for gold, experience, and strong cards for your deck!

notes.title: Eternal Destiny: A Christmas present for you! (update)
notes.notes:
Time to get your deck ready for Christmas! Today we bring you a Christmas update!

Goddess - CPU Battle is Available
CPU Battle in Goddess mode is now available! You can obtain six kinds of 5-star rare cards with the non-evolved/evolved/super evolved for each!

    Easy： Clear "Scenario 10"
    Normal： Clear all five DLCs
    Hard： Clear on Easy and Normal 

Since we're still preparing the newest DLC, please try on Easy first, and get ready for the next update!


Extra Dungeon: The Tune of X'mas
Can't wait for Christmas? Here is a brand new dungeon where you can challenge cute Christmas fairies and get Christmas themed cards! 
But be careful, they are pretty strong despite their cute appearance... ;)
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/23341885/708a92e3b0beaffe47c24a3145fdba9ecaa6a852.jpg
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/23341885/154c50b1fc484f5fa2c090d9936109dd4aabec4f.png

Enjoy!

notes.title: Eternal Destiny: Card pack update & New DLC release
notes.notes:
Update Patch

Added 12 Angels package in the game shop!
Strengthen your deck with gorgeous and powerful angels.
** These 12 cards are included as a bonus in the new DLC

New DLC "Angel's Ladder: Next Manhattan Project" is now available
New scenario: Rumors whisper that Cybers have restarted the "Next Manhattan" Project. This could have catastrophic results for the entire planet.
Go with your navigator to verify the rumors and stop the project if true. The fate of Earth is in your hands!
New dungeon: Explore the holiest place, scout new allies, and strengthen your deck! 
Bonus 13 cards!: Receive 12+1 of the new cards as a bonus for buying the DLC

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/23341885/40340ebcd11ae3838014090ad8057bcd17aeee5f.png
** All these cards are available through normal play, as Rare drops.

http://store.steampowered.com/app/530480
